ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited's EVOQ360 Home Lift business shows encouraging operational growth, securing confirmed advance orders for approximately 60 units and dispatching 19 units in Q2 FY26-27, reflecting positive market acceptance. This progress is bolstered by an expanding distribution network with five new partners, poised to materially impact future revenue generation for this product segment. No significant red flags are present, though the update focuses purely on operational metrics rather than detailed financial performance.
